/**
 * The Specialists 3.0's mp.dll matches the generic Windows g_pGameRules signature in
 * globalvars.engine.txt twice, and the first match (a sound precache) reads another global, so
 * fakemeta's get/set_gamerules_* natives were disabled. This one only matches CWorld::Precache.
 */

"Games"
{
	"#default"
	{
		"#supported"
		{
			"game"            "ts"
			"gamedll_export"  "!ReTS_GetInterface"
		}

		"Signatures"
		{
			"g_pGameRules" // CGameRules *g_pGameRules
			{
				"library"   "server"
				"windows"   "\x68\x2A\x2A\x2A\x2A\xFF\x15\x2A\x2A\x2A\x2A\xA1\x2A\x2A\x2A\x2A\x83\xC4\x18\x85\xC0\x74\x2A\x50\xE8" // CWorld::Precache() on "room_type"
				"linux"     "@g_pGameRules"
				"mac"       "@g_pGameRules"
			}
		}
	}
}
